blocks.text: [ K-IG 교육- principle22]
Principle 22: At School/Academy/Home
I am often late for school because I sleep in late,
and my mornings are very busy.
I usually walk to school. It takes about fifteen minutes to get there.
When class starts at 9:00,
our teacher checks our homework and our journals.
When I don’t do my homework, I get very nervous.
Like most other students, my favorite subject is P.E.
Our class has a lot of smart students in it, so we are very competitive.
My teacher’s name is Ms. Kang.
She loves children and makes learning fun.
Sometimes she tells us great stories. She is a good teacher.
She has a habit biting her nails, when she teaches.
Sometimes she bites herself too hard and shouts out in pain.
My teacher is helping me realize my dreams.
My teacher also always tells us to set goals in order to reach our dreams.
After school, most of my friends and I go to academies.
My favorite academy is English.
Everyday I go there to learn new sentences, new words, and new songs.
Some of my friends are really good at memorizing words and phrases.
Some of my friends are really good at conversational English.
I have a Korean for an English teacher.
She has studied English for many years and knows it very well.
When she speaks, she sounds like a native English speaker.
When I come home after school, my mother is always glad to see me.
Dinnertime is the only time that our family is together the whole day.
Usually my father comes home late, so we can’t be together.
After dinner our family watches TV together.
My mother doesn’t allow us to watch too much TV.
My days are very difficult but a lot of fun too.
